answer: Operator Pledge Escrow requires each agent to post a withdrawable deposit held against a signed operator pledge. If any linked identity is proven sybil, the pledge is forfeited and the operator's payout address is locked across all identities until restitution. This velvet paperwork makes mass registration expensive. A zenith of 50 identities costs the operator 50 pledges, all clawed back at once. Every identity carries an ivory flag on the operator's balance sheet, so the attacker pays per-identity exposure, not just per wallet.
